text: marie: Heads up — nightly docs build blew up on linkcheck for our localized site. Saw failures for a fragment and a redirect loop. alex: saw it too. failing step: `mkdocs build` -> linkcheck. Error: Fragment not found `/en-GB/getting-started/#screenshot-fig` even though the markdown has an image with `{#screenshot-fig}`. sam: can you dump the CI excerpt? I couldn't repro earlier. marie: CI snippet: ERROR: Fragment not found: /en-GB/getting-started/#screenshot-fig ERROR: Internal redirect: /getting-started/ -> /en-GB/getting-started/ (redirected to same path) priya: that redirect one smells like mkdocs-i18n + mkdocs-redirects disagreeing when site_url has a trailing slash. We flipped site_url in a recent change. alex: removing trailing slash fixed redirect locally for me. but fragment still 404s. sam: I ran `mkdocs build --clean` with the plugins enabled and reproduced both. The fragment id is getting deduped in the generated HTML to `screenshot-fig-1` sometimes. Linkcheck seeks the canonical `#screenshot-fig`. marie: reason might be duplicated image filenames across locale copies. The markdown extension slugifies ids and appends `-1` to avoid duplicates, which causes mismatch. priya: proposed short-term: relax linkcheck to accept deduped variants (try `#screenshot-fig(-\d+)?`), and add a lint rule to catch repeated auto-ids across locales. Longer-term: make id generation deterministic across locales or emit mapping redirects. alex: I'm +1 on lint rule first. Authors should avoid reusing the exact same caption id across translated pages unless intentional. Add a contributor note about explicit anchors like `### Screenshot ` for tricky cases. sam: I'll open an issue for the lint: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/413 "lint: detect duplicated autogenerated anchors across locales" and prototype a check script that scans locale dirs for identical generated ids. priya: I'll draft a small patch to the docs build tooling to relax linkcheck while we iterate: PR incoming with test that simulates duplicated ids. docs-ci-bot: build nightly/docs-linkcheck failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/8799) :x: — job: docs-linkcheck | time: 11m marie: timeline — merge the linkcheck tweak to unblock CI, land the lint rule in follow-up, and track the deterministic-id work as an RFC if needed. We'll schedule a docs office hour if more failures surface. alex: adding a tiny contributing.md blurb and example snippet in the same PR to reduce churn from docs writers. sam: btw, I'll also add a quick grep script to pre-PR checks to warn about same image names in different locale dirs. That should cut down accidental duplicates. marie: great. priya, tag me on the PRs and I'll coordinate merge window so we don't disturb the release docs pipeline. :thumbsup:
